from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe')
r=subprocess.run(['git','status','--short'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
print('PRE_TEST_STATUS',r.stdout)
allowed={'adapters/protocol.py','do-again.toml','do-again-policy.json','tests/test_job_discovery.py'}
for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
 name=line[3:]
 if name not in allowed: raise SystemExit('UNEXPECTED_DIRTY_PATH '+name)
check=subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
if check!='9a2adc97d6dc3eab1f3c9bfa61cb5cd5076eebd4': raise SystemExit('HEAD_CHANGED')
cmd=[str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-m','pytest','-q','--maxfail=1']
proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:
 out,err=proc.communicate(timeout=380)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
 os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
 try: out,err=proc.communicate(timeout=8)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
  out,err=proc.communicate()
 print('FULL_SUITE_TIMED_OUT')
 print(out[-3200:])
 print(err[-900:])
 raise SystemExit(124)
print('FULL_SUITE_EXIT',proc.returncode)
print(out[-3800:])
print(err[-700:])
if proc.returncode: raise SystemExit(proc.returncode)
subprocess.run(['git','add','--','tests/test_job_discovery.py'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','commit','-m','test: preserve canonical application URL distinct from source'],cwd=repo,check=True)
subprocess.run(['git','push','origin','main'],cwd=repo,check=True,timeout=90)
print('VERIFIED_PUSH')
